# Display snippets for docs/term_inspection.md (Fields by Name)

--8<-- [start:default_values]
with_defaults(TERM, RESULT) <- (
    vary({"color": "black", "size": 12}, TERM, RESULT)
)
--8<-- [end:default_values]

--8<-- [start:inspect_fields]
needs_input(TERM) <- (
    unbound_keys(TERM, KEYS),
    length(KEYS, N),
    N > 0
)
--8<-- [end:inspect_fields]

--8<-- [start:reflect_predicate]
describe_predicate(NAME, ARITY) <- (
    signature(NAME, ARITY, FIELD_NAMES),
    writeln_text(f"Predicate {NAME}/{ARITY}"),
    writeln_text(f"Fields: {FIELD_NAMES}")
)
--8<-- [end:reflect_predicate]
